metadata.description: The method behind landings that don't read as templates: one authored moment that makes the page's promise visible, a craft floor, and a cliche detector.

plugins.name: landing-moment
plugins.description: Design landing pages around one authored moment derived from the copy, with a copy gate, a mechanical craft floor, and two zero-dependency tools: a cliche detector over the source and an auditor that measures the rendered page in a real Chrome. Four production case studies plus a full worked example.
